scope: All-synthetic, all-exposed diagnostic regression; not unseen acceptance
diagnostics: Record every metadata-eligible candidate before retained-budget slicing
Separate metadata_filter from route_budget; never relax publication, version or permissions
Legacy traces without eligibility remain ambiguous rather than retroactively relabelled
For each lost evidence record raw, eligible and retained ranks for both routes
selection: Compare each pool evidence hit against the rerun 2:1/15:15 baseline, development heading coverage, final selection side effects and query cost. Prefer bounded improvement without new pool evidence losses; do not claim the best proportion globally.
stop_rules: Only test the three frozen proportions and three keyword budgets; no repeated fine tuning if no useful gain
If val017 remains missing from raw candidates or retained pool, investigate its matching/rank evidence before considering a separately frozen controlled-term experiment
Do not change frozen questions/answers, model or reranking to rescue measured cases
Default configuration and business deployment remain unchanged
